title: Miss Nov 30 and your trade licence costs 25% more

slides.head: Miss Nov 30 and your trade licence costs 25% more
What happened
slides.body: CMC Commissioner G. Srijana announced renewal of existing trade licences for Jan 1 to Dec 31, 2027.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: Renewals from Dec 1, 2026 to Jan 31, 2027 attract a 25% penalty under the applicable provisions.

slides.head: Did you know
slides.body: Renewed licences cover Jan 1 to Dec 31, 2027.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: SMS renewal demands from CMC to traders in the coming days. Ask: How many traders in CMC limits hold licences due for renewal?

slides.head: Spill the tea, daily
slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news

captions.instagram:
Miss Nov 30 and your trade licence costs 25% more

Cyberabad Municipal Corporation wants all trade licences renewed for 2027 by November 30, 2026, or penalties kick in.

Why it matters: Renewals from Dec 1, 2026 to Jan 31, 2027 attract a 25% penalty under the applicable provisions.

Source: Telangana Today. Image: Telangana Today
